address: Pipers Ley, Burstall Hill, Burstall, Ipswich, Suffolk, IP8 3ED
description: Converting and extending the existing garage with a new first floor, two front dormers and new rear patio doors linking through to the house, adding valuable extra space to a home near Ipswich.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Eustace asked Architecture ONE to make better use of the garage at Pipers Ley, Burstall Hill, near Ipswich, turning underused space into a proper part of the home.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The design raises a new first floor above the garage and adds two front dormers for light, together with new rear patio doors and a link through to the main house, tying the extended space into day-to-day living.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Babergh District Council granted planning permission for the scheme in June 2018 (application ref. DC/18/01868).
